neighbours.label: the comma after a stranded preposition whose object is deferred to the end of a coordination (responsible for, and must report on, all repairs; attracted to, but wary of, the technology)
fire: The agency will monitor, and where necessary intervene in, the sale of farmland to foreign buyers.
Teachers should be aware of, and sensitive to, the pressures their pupils face at home.
The new rules apply to, but were not drafted for, small family businesses.
Residents have long complained about, and petitioned against, the night flights over the estuary.
The museum cares for, and regularly lends from, a collection of some forty thousand prints.
Doctors must listen to, and act on, concerns raised by nursing staff.
The fund invests in, and occasionally takes control of, struggling regional airlines.
Every applicant is interviewed by, and must be approved by, two members of the board.
quiet: The agency will monitor the sale of farmland to foreign buyers and intervene where necessary.
Teachers should be sensitive to the pressures their pupils face at home.
The new rules apply to small family businesses, although they were not drafted for them.
Residents have long complained about the night flights over the estuary and petitioned against them.
The museum cares for a collection of some forty thousand prints and regularly lends from it.
Doctors must act on concerns raised by nursing staff.
The fund invests in struggling regional airlines and occasionally takes control of them.
Every applicant is interviewed by two members of the board, who must then approve the appointment.

predictions: 6-7/8 fire; probe 'attracted to, but wary of,' 0.59, 'advice to, and campaigns on behalf of,' 0.45, 'responsible for, and must report on,' 0.35; the same construction without the comma ('production of and trade in') only 0.09; unstranded twins 0.02-0.08
notes: Card: max 155, peaks ',' x14 and ' for' x8 in right-node-raising coordinations (prevent, prepare for, and respond to; benefit from, if not require; designed for, and used, by). The + pole suppresses 'and'/'or'. Probe showed the comma carries most of the activation. Near misses rewrite each item with the object in place and no stranding.
